elements.element: Maintain commercial general liability insurance with a limit of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.
elements.evidence: The clause requires TrueLink to maintain commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.

elements.element: Maintain commercial general liability insurance with an aggregate limit of at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: The clause requires a USD 2,000,000 aggregate commercial general liability limit.

elements.element: Maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: The clause requires professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000.

elements.element: If the vendor processes Customer Data, maintain cyber and privacy liability insurance of at least USD 5,000,000.
elements.evidence: Where TrueLink processes data belonging to, supplied by, or processed for Client, the clause requires cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000. This supplies the required coverage and limit when the processing condition applies.

elements.element: Maintain workers' compensation insurance as required by law.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly requires workers' compensation insurance as required by law.

elements.element: Provide certificates of insurance upon request.
elements.evidence: TrueLink must provide certificates of insurance upon Client's request.

elements.element: Maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of at least USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: The operative USD 2,000,000 E&O requirement exceeds the USD 1,000,000 fallback minimum.

elements.element: If the vendor processes Customer Data, maintain cyber and privacy liability insurance of at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: The operative clause requires USD 5,000,000 of cyber and privacy liability insurance when TrueLink processes Client data, exceeding the USD 2,000,000 fallback minimum.

result.reason: The added operative insurance covenant includes every preferred coverage, threshold, condition, and certificate obligation. It therefore also exceeds both fallback thresholds. The unchanged force-majeure provision remains effective, and the added language is confined to the requested insurance requirements.
